blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Reliable and practical audio-visual DeepFake detection requires benchmarks that reflect diverse linguistic contexts and modern data synthesis pipelines for visual as well as audio manipulations. However, existing datasets predominantly contain footage of English-speakers, often include outdated manipulation types, or overlook the audio modality. Further, many datasets feature individuals who did not consent to be used in DeepFake creation.
We introduce BabelFake , a multilingual audio-visual DeepFake benchmark recorded with consenting participants. BabelFake contains 399k clips (1,323 hours) from 496 individuals spanning five languages (English, German, Italian, French, Spanish). Our modular data generation pipeline pairs 11 modern video manipulation methods with 4 voice cloning engines, distinguishing visual-only (face swapping) and joint audio-visual manipulations (lip synchronization and portrait animation).
By benchmarking state-of-the-art detectors, we show that detection difficulty depends on the audio-visual generation pairing, with substantial performance degradation when authentic audio is preserved. Cross-language/demographic evaluation reveals sensitivity varying across detector architectures and training data, while human evaluation reveals that perceived realism and machine-detection difficulty do not necessarily align.
blocks.zh:
可靠而实用的视听 " 深假 " 探测需要反映不同语言背景的基准和用于视觉和音频操纵的现代数据合成管道。 然而,现有的数据集主要包含英语语言的镜头,通常包括过时的操控类型,或者忽略了音频模式. 此外,许多数据集的特点是不同意用于DeepFake创建的个人。
我们介绍Babel Fake, 这是一个多语种的视听DeepFake基准, Babel Fake包含399k个剪辑(1,323小时),来自496个人,跨越了5种语言(英语,德语,意大利语,法语,西班牙语). 我们的模块化数据生成管道配对11个现代视频操纵方法,并配有4个语音克隆引擎,区分出仅可视化(相机交换)和相声-相机操纵(平面同步和肖像动画).
通过设定最先进的探测器的基准,我们显示探测困难取决于视听生成的配对,当真实的音频被保存时,其性能会大幅退化. 跨语言/人口评价显示,各种探测器结构和培训数据的敏感性各不相同,而人类评价则显示,所认为的现实主义和机器探测困难不一定一致。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The rapid evolution of generative models has dramatically increased the realism and accessibility of synthetic media. Modern frameworks can seamlessly clone speech [ 34 , 41 , 59 ] , reenact facial dynamics [ 39 , 53 ] , or entirely replace identities in video [ 14 , 55 ] . While enabling beneficial applications, they also pose severe risks for disinformation and digital impersonation [ 23 , 2 , 21 ] , making robust DeepFake detection a matter of priority.
blocks.zh: 基因模型的迅速演变使合成媒介的现实主义和可获取性大为增加. 现代框架可以无缝地复制语音[34,41,59],再现面部动态[39,53],或者完全取代视频中的身份[14,55]. 它们虽然有利于有益的应用,但也给虚假信息和数字化冒用带来严重风险[23、2、21],使强大的 " 深假 " 探测成为优先事项。

blocks.en:
Progress in DeepFake detection is driven by benchmarks. Early visual DeepFake datasets, such as FaceForensics++ [ 42 ] , Celeb-DF [ 31 ] , KoDF [ 29 ] , and DFDC [ 18 ] , significantly advanced research in detecting visual manipulation. More recently, audio-visual datasets such as FakeAVCeleb [ 27 ] , LAV-DF [ 11 ] , and DeepSpeak [ 9 ] have advanced the development of multimodal detection approaches that jointly analyze audio and visual information.
Despite these advances, existing datasets present several critical limitations: (i) Monolingual Bias : most datasets remain predominantly English-centric, and the emerging multilingual datasets [ 52 , 16 ] originate from uncontrolled web-scraped media; (ii) Outdated Manipulation Types : although manipulation capabilities improved during the four-year span from FakeAVCeleb to DeepSpeak, the latter still retains some older manipulation types, limiting its alignment with contemporary deepfake generation frameworks; (iii) Overlooked Audio : existing audio-visual benchmarks are heavily skewed towards visual manipulations. While they provide extensive variations of face swapping and lip synchronization, they include few audio manipulations; (iv) Consent : the vast majority of DeepFake benchmarks scrape videos of public figures or online users without explicit consent, raising privacy and data-use concerns.
blocks.zh:
深假检测的进展受基准驱动. 早期的视觉"深层假"数据集,如FaceForensics++ [42],Celeb-DF [31],KoDF [29],和DFDC [18],在探测视觉操纵方面有显著的进步研究. 最近,诸如FakeAVCeleb [27],LAV-DF [11],和DeepSpeak [9]等视听数据集已推进了联合分析视听信息的多模式检测方法的发展.
尽管取得了这些进展,但现有数据集存在若干关键限制:(一) 单一语言比亚语:大多数数据集仍然以英语为主,新出现的多语种数据集[52、16]源于不受控制的网络碎裂媒体;(二) 过时的操纵类型:虽然在从FakeAVCeleb到DeepSpeak的4年期间,操纵能力有所提高,但DeepSpeak仍然保留一些更古老的操纵类型,限制了它与当代深假生成框架的一致性;(三) 被忽略的音频:现有的视听基准严重偏向于视觉操纵。 虽然它们提供了面相交换和口语同步的广泛变化,但它们包括很少的音频操纵;(四) 同意:绝大多数DeepFake基准在未经明确同意的情况下刮去公众人物或在线用户的视频,引起隐私和数据使用问题。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Comparison between BabelFake and other recent multilingual DeepFake datasets. For ILLUSION, only set D (video subset) is included in the comparison, as it is the only one considering the multilingual scenario, UnK means unknown.
blocks.zh: 表1: BabelFake与其他近期多语种DeepFake数据集的比较. 对ILLUSION来说,比较中只包含设置 D(视频子集),因为它是唯一一个考虑多语种情景,UnK表示未知.

blocks.en: To overcome these limitations, we introduce BabelFake , a multilingual audio-visual DeepFake benchmark recorded with consenting participants and approved by our Institutional Review Board (IRB, an ethics committee). Captured via a controlled webcam protocol, the dataset reflects realistic remote communication scenarios. It comprises recordings from speakers in five languages (English, German, French, Italian, and Spanish) who explicitly consent to the collection, processing, and release of their data for academic research. All recordings were captured on personal devices in unconstrained home environments from diverse geographic locations, ensuring natural variability while maintaining consistent acquisition constraints. To capture realistic conversational behavior, our protocol incorporates a structured task hierarchy spanning phonetically rich reading, quick-fire Q&A, spontaneous open-ended storytelling, and action- or gesture-based prompts.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些限制,我们引入了Babel Fake,这是一个多语种的视听DeepFake基准,得到与会者的同意,并获得我们机构审查委员会(一个道德委员会)的批准。 通过受控的网络相机协议被捕获,数据集反映了现实的远程通信情景. 它包括五种语言(英语、德语、法语、意大利语和西班牙语)的发言者的录音,他们明确同意收集、处理和公布其学术研究数据。 所有录音都记录在来自不同地理位置的不受限制的家庭环境中的个人设备上,确保自然变异,同时保持持续的购置限制。 为了捕捉现实的谈话行为,我们的协议包含了一个结构化的任务层次, 包括口语丰富的阅读,快火QQA,自发的开放式讲故事,以及基于行动或手势的提示。

blocks.en: Next, we implement a data generation protocol that addresses audio modality under-representation. We combine 11 state-of-the-art video manipulation methods with 4 recent multilingual voice-cloning engines. This design covers visual-only generation (Face Swapping), and joint audio-visual manipulations (Lip Synchronization and Portrait Animation) conditioned on both pristine and synthetic audio.
blocks.zh: 其次,我们实施一个数据生成协议,解决音频模式表达不足的问题。 我们把11个最先进的视频操纵方法与最近4个多语言语音克隆引擎结合起来. 这种设计涵盖了只可视化的生成(Face Swapping),以及以原始音频和合成音频为条件的联合视听操纵(Lip Synchronization和Portrait Animation).

blocks.en: We benchmark several state-of-the-art DeepFake detectors (SpeechForensics [ 33 ] , AVH-Align [ 48 ] , (B)RAVEn [ 22 ] ) on BabelFake. Our evaluation reveals that existing detectors suffer performance drops when visual manipulations are paired with authentic audio, hinting at over-reliance on cross-modal synchronization cues in multimodal models. While multimodal models generally outperform their unimodal counterparts, their advantage varies considerably across audio-video generation combinations. Finally, multilingual evaluation shows no language is consistently harder to detect, but highlights language sensitivity in the detector architecture and training data.
blocks.zh: 我们以Babel Fake为基准确定若干最先进的深假探测器(SpeechForensics [33], AVH-Align [48], (B)RAVEN [22]). 我们的评价表明,当视觉操纵与真实音频配对时,现有探测器的性能会下降,这表明在多式联运模式中过度依赖跨模式同步提示。 虽然多式联运模式一般优于单一模式模式,但其优势因音频-视频生成组合而有很大差异。 最后,多语种评价显示没有任何语言总是更难被检测,而是突出检测器架构和培训数据中的语言敏感性.

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows: (i) Ethically Sourced Benchmark: we release BabelFake, an IRB-approved multilingual DeepFake detection dataset featuring recordings with consenting participants across 5 languages, ensuring diverse linguistic/demographic representation and responsible data use; (ii) Modality-Disentangled Generation Pipeline : we introduce a modular generation protocol pairing 11 video manipulation engines with 4 voice-cloning models, covering video-only manipulations alongside audio-visual DeepFakes under both authentic and synthesized speech conditions; (iii) Diagnostic Insights: we present a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art multimodal detectors, exposing their blind spots to authentic audio and analyzing their cross-lingual robustness. BabelFake also enables analysis across demographic groups.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献可归纳如下:(一) 道德来源基准:我们发布Babel Fake,这是由IRB核准的多语种DeepFake检测数据集,由5种语言的参与者同意进行录音,确保语言/人口表达方式的多样性和负责任的数据使用;(二) 模块化-分散式生成管道:我们采用模块化生成协议,将11个视频操纵引擎配以4个语音克隆模型,在真实和综合的语音条件下,仅涵盖视频操纵和视听DeepFake;(三) 诊断洞察:我们对最新多模式检测器进行全面评价,使其盲点暴露于真实的音频并分析其跨语言强度。 宝贝 假象还有助于对各人口群体进行分析。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Audio-Visual DeepFake Datasets. The availability of large-scale datasets plays a crucial role in advancing audio-visual DeepFake detection. Early datasets, such as DFDC [ 18 ] , primarily focus on visual manipulation and large-scale face-swapping scenarios. To support multimodal detection, FakeAVCeleb [ 27 ] introduces synchronized manipulations on both facial and speech, enabling the study of audio-visual inconsistency arising from jointly manipulated content. More recently, DeepSpeak [ 9 ] expands the diversity of manipulation methods and generation pipelines, providing more challenging benchmarks for multimodal DeepFake detection. Despite these advances, existing audio-visual datasets are primarily designed to improve manipulation diversity and scale, while offering limited support for systematic analysis across languages and modality configurations. These aspects are essential for understanding the robustness and generalization capabilities of current DeepFake detectors.
blocks.zh: 视听深假数据集. 大型数据集的提供对于推进视听"深假"探测具有关键作用. 早期数据集,如DFDC [18] ,主要关注视觉操纵和大规模相貌分辨假想. 为了支持多模式检测,FakeAVCeleb [27] 引入了面部和口语的同步操纵,使得能够研究由共同被操纵的内容引起的视听不一致. 最近,DeepSpeak [9] 扩大了操纵方法和生成管道的多样性,为多式DeepFake检测提供了更具挑战性的基准. 尽管取得了这些进展,但现有的视听数据集主要旨在改进操纵的多样性和规模,同时为跨语言和模式配置的系统分析提供有限的支持。 这些方面对于理解当前"深假"探测器的强性和通俗性能力至关重要.

blocks.en: Multilingual DeepFake Datasets. The growing availability of multilingual generative models has motivated the development of DeepFake benchmarks that extend beyond English. Early efforts include KoDF [ 29 ] , which introduces Korean-speaking subjects for visual DeepFake detection. More recently, multilingual audio-visual benchmarks such as PolyGlotFake [ 24 ] and MAVOS-DD [ 16 ] have expanded the linguistic diversity of DeepFake datasets by including multiple languages, subjects, and generation methods. ILLUSION [ 52 ] further introduces a large-scale benchmark spanning image, audio, video, and audio-visual DeepFakes. However, to the best of our knowledge, among its subsets, only subset D supports the multilingual scenario , while the remaining subsets primarily focus on large-scale multimodal generation in English. Consequently, only Set D is considered in our comparison. 1 1 1 We were not able to access the data to confirm all the details.
blocks.zh: 多语言深假数据集. 多语种基因模型的日益普及,推动了DeepFake基准的发展,超越了英语. 早期的努力包括了KoDF [29],它引入了韩语的主体来进行视觉"深假"检测. 最近,PolyGlotFake[24]和MAVOS-DD[16]等多语种视听基准通过包括多种语言,主题和生成方法,扩大了DeepFake数据集的语言多样性. ILLUSION [52] 进一步引入了跨越图像、音频、视频和视听深层假象的大规模基准。 然而,据我们所知,在其子集中,只有子集D支持多语种情景,而其余子集则主要侧重于英语的大规模多模式生成. 因此,在比较时只考虑设置D。 1个 1,我们无法获取数据确认所有细节.

blocks.en: Although these datasets represent important steps towards multilingual evaluation, as shown in Tab. 1 , BabelFake is the first multilingual audio-visual DeepFake benchmark to combine consented and controlled data acquisition with multiple manipulation modalities, including face swapping, lip-syncing, avatar generation, and audio DeepFakes, thereby enabling a comprehensive evaluation of detector robustness across languages and manipulation types.
blocks.zh: 虽然如Tab所示,这些数据集是走向多语种评价的重要步骤。 1, BabelFake是第一个将同意和控制的数据获取与多种操纵方式相结合的多语言视听DeepFake基准,包括面相交换,唇相呼应,相声生成,和音频DeepFakes,从而能够对跨语言的探测力和操纵类型进行全面的评价.

blocks.en: 3 BabelFake: Real Data Collection
blocks.zh: 3 Babel 假: 真实的数据收集

blocks.en: In this section we outline our scheme for real data recording, with the goal to later facilitate multilingual multimodal DeepFake data generation (described in Sec. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们概述了我们的真实数据记录计划,目的是今后促进多语种多式DeepFake数据生成(见第4节)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Design Goals
blocks.zh: 3.1 设计目标

blocks.en: The design of BabelFake was guided by three primary objectives: ethical data collection, multilingual coverage, and realistic data acquisition conditions. First, unlike many existing DeepFake benchmarks that rely on publicly available online footage, we adopt a consent-first acquisition strategy, in which participants explicitly agree to the collection, processing, and public release of their recordings for research purposes. Additionally, the data acquisition protocol was reviewed and approved by our institutional ethics committee. This approach addresses the growing concerns regarding privacy, data ownership, and the ethical use of biometric information in DeepFake research [ 35 , 1 ] .
blocks.zh: Babel Fake的设计以三个主要目标为指导:道德数据收集、多语种覆盖面和现实的数据获取条件。 首先,我们与许多依靠公开的在线录像的现有DeepFake基准不同,我们采取了首先同意的获取战略,参与者明确同意为研究目的收集、处理和公开发布录音。 此外,我们的机构道德委员会审查并批准了数据获取程序。 这种方法解决了对隐私、数据所有权和在DeepFake研究中以道德方式使用生物鉴别信息等越来越多的关切[35, 1]。

blocks.en: Second, the dataset is designed to support multilingual DeepFake detection. While modern generative approaches can produce DeepFakes in many languages, most existing benchmarks remain English-centric. To address this limitation, BabelFake includes recordings in five languages - English (en), German (de), Italian (it), French (fr), and Spanish (es) - enabling the study of language-specific effects and cross-language generalization. Moreover, we do not only capture distinct languages, but, consequently, distinct geographic locations and ethnic groups (see Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 第二,数据集旨在支持多语种"深假"检测. 虽然现代的基因方法可以产生多种语言的"深假"(DeepFake),但大多数现有的基准仍然是以英语为中心的. 为解决这一限制,Babel Fake包括五种语言的录音,即英语(en)、德语(de)、意大利语(it)、法语(fr)和西班牙语(es),从而能够研究语言特定效应和跨语言通俗化。 此外,我们不仅掌握不同的语言,因此也掌握不同的地理位置和族裔群体(见图1)。

blocks.en: Finally, the dataset aims to capture realistic webcam-based interactions. As remote interactions become increasingly common, these settings represent an important real-world deployment scenario for DeepFake detection systems. All recordings were collected using participants’ personal devices in an unconstrained home environment, while following standardized recording protocol designed to ensure good audio and video quality.
blocks.zh: 最后,数据集旨在捕捉基于网络相机的现实互动. 随着远程互动越来越普遍,这些设置是DeepFake探测系统的重要现实世界部署情景. 所有录音都是在不受限制的家庭环境中使用参与者的个人装置收集的,同时遵循为确保良好的视听质量而设计的标准化录音规程。

blocks.en: 3.2 Participant Recruitment and Consent
blocks.zh: 3.2 征聘和同意

blocks.en:
Participants were recruited through the Prolific 2 2 2 https://www.prolific.com/ crowdsourcing platform and were financially compensated based on the estimated study duration (ca. 40 minutes), following Prolific’s recommended hourly compensation guidelines (£9/hour). Data collection was conducted in four stages: an initial pilot study, followed by three collection phases. Each language was collected through a dedicated study, with the target language as the primary criterion for recruitment. To avoid duplicate participants and ensure unique identities in the dataset, participants who completed any collection study were excluded from all subsequent studies. For more details, see Appendix C .
Before starting the recording phase, participants reviewed a detailed consent form (see Appendix A ). The form explains the study’s purpose, data recording and storing, public dataset release, potential risks, and how to withdraw consent.
blocks.zh:
学员是通过Prolific 2 2 2 https://www.prolific.com/众包平台招聘的,并按照Prolific建议的小时报酬准则(9英镑/小时),根据估计学习时间(约40分钟)获得财务补偿。 数据收集分四个阶段进行:初步试点研究,然后是三个收集阶段。 每个语言都是通过专门研究收集的,目标语言是征聘的主要标准。 为避免重复参与者并确保数据集中的独特身份,已完成任何收集研究的参与者被排除在随后的所有研究之外。 详情见附录C。
在开始记录阶段之前,与会者审查了详细的同意表(见附录A)。 表格解释了研究的目的、数据记录和储存、公共数据集的发布、潜在风险以及如何撤回同意。

blocks.en: 3.3 Recording Protocol & Speech Content
blocks.zh: 3.3 记录协议和发言内容

blocks.en: We collect the data through a custom web-based platform; participants complete the task on their own devices in their everyday environments. Our recording protocol combines scripted reading, spontaneous Q&A interactions, open responses, emotional speech prompts, and action-based instructions, inspired by DeepSpeak [ 9 ] . Jointly, these tasks capture a wide range of speech patterns, facial expressions, head poses, gestures, and natural behaviors typical of everyday video calls.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一个定制的网络平台收集数据;参与者在日常环境中用自己的设备完成任务。 我们的录音协议结合了脚本读取,自发的QQA互动,开放的响应,情感的演讲提示,以及基于行动的指示,由DeepSpeak[9]所启发. 联合起来,这些任务捕捉了各种语音模式,面部表情,头部姿势,手势,以及日常视频通话所典型的自然行为.

blocks.en: For voice cloning tasks, participants complete a set of standardized speech tasks. These tasks provide broad phonetic coverage and allow direct comparison among speakers of the same language. Specifically, participants record a language-specific version of “The North Wind and the Sun” [ 3 ] and a set of phonetically balanced sentences.
blocks.zh: 对于语音克隆任务,参与者完成一套标准化的语音任务. 这些任务提供了广泛的语音报道,并允许同一种语言的讲者进行直接比较。 具体地说,与会者录制了一个针对具体语言的"北风与太阳"[3]版本和一套口语平衡的句子.

blocks.en: To capture natural speaking behavior, participants complete question-answering (e.g., concise answers) and open-ended (e.g., spontaneous storytelling) responses to encourage natural habits like pauses, hesitations, filler words, varying speech rates, and spontaneous gestures.
blocks.zh: 为了捕捉自然说话行为,参与者完成问答(如:简洁的答案)和可自由参加的(如:自发地讲故事)响应,来鼓励暂停,犹豫,填词等自然习惯,语音率不同,以及自发的手势.

blocks.en: We also include emotional reading prompts to add variety to both audio and video. These prompts capture changes in tone, intonation, speaking rate, facial expressions, and emotional behavior across happy, sad, and neutral speech.
blocks.zh: 我们还包括情感阅读提示,为音频和视频增加多样性。 这些提示可以捕捉到语气、入内、语速、面部表情和情感行为的变化,

blocks.en: Finally, participants follow action-based instructions that mimic behaviors common in real-world video calls. These tasks trigger movements, gaze shifts, facial expressions, partial face obstructions, and speech-related gestures, which provide extra visual variety needed for audio-video DeepFake generation and detection.
blocks.zh: 最后,参与者遵循基于行动的指示,即模仿现实世界视频通话中常见的行为. 这些任务触发了运动,目光转向,面部表情,部分面部阻塞等与语音相关的手势,为音频-视频DeepFake生成和检测提供了额外的视觉多样性.

blocks.en: We choose text prompts that maximize linguistic diversity and phonetic coverage, while ensuring content safety. Further details on prompt sources, filtering procedures, and prompt selection are presented in Sec. C.3 ; the text prompts are given in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 我们选择文本提示,尽量扩大语言多样性和语音覆盖面,同时确保内容安全。 关于即时源、过滤程序和即时选择的进一步详情载于Sec.C.3;文本提示载于附录D。

blocks.en: 4 BabelFake: DeepFake Generation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4 Babel Fake:深假生成管道

blocks.en: Starting from the pristine recordings described in Sec. 3 , we generate manipulated samples via a modular pipeline combining preprocessing, controlled identity pairing, multilingual voice cloning, and multiple types of video manipulation (both visual-only and audio-visual).
blocks.zh: 从第3节所描述的原始录音开始,我们通过一个模块化的管道生成被操纵的样品,该管道结合了预处理,控制身份配对,多语种语音克隆,以及多种类型的视频操纵(既包括视觉操作,也包括视听操作).

blocks.en: 4.1 Preprocessing Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4.1 预处理管道

blocks.en: Raw recordings collected via our web acquisition platform are standardized to MP4 (H.264 video, AAC audio at 48kHz). To support text-driven audio synthesis, we transcribe the authentic recordings using Whisper Large [ 40 ] and post-process the transcripts with Gemini 2.5 [ 51 ] to remove transcription errors and ensure grammatical flow for text-to-speech (TTS) voice synthesis input.
blocks.zh: 通过我们的网络收购平台收集的原始录音被标准化为MP4(H.264视频,AAC音频在48kHz). 为了支持由文本驱动的音频合成,我们使用Whisper Large[40]来转录正版录音,然后用双子座2.5[51]处理记录誊本,去除抄录错误,确保文本到语音合成输入的语法流.

blocks.en: For generative pipelines based on cloned speech, audio tracks are resampled to 16kHz. To prevent temporal-looping artifacts or unrealistic static padding, we enforce strict audio-visual duration alignment by trimming the source video when it exceeds the driving audio by more than 0.5s and discarding samples where the driving audio exceeds the video length. Full encoding, frame rate handling, and alignment thresholds are detailed in Sec. F.1 .
blocks.zh: 对于基于克隆语音的基因管,音频音轨被再被复制到16kHz. 为了防止时空取出文物或不切实际的静态粘贴,我们实施严格的视听持续时间调整,在超过驱动音频时将源视频修剪0.5分以上,并在驱动音频超过视频长度时丢弃样本. 完整编码,帧速率处理,和对齐阈值详见Sec.F.1.

blocks.en: 4.2 Identity Pairing
blocks.zh: 4.2 身份对等

blocks.en:
To generate realistic identity manipulations, BabelFake employs a controlled demographic pairing strategy for both facial and vocal identities. For face-based manipulations, each target participant is paired with a source using a hierarchical demographic matcher. The demographic matcher is based on the language, sex, age bucket (18-35, 35-50, 50+), and ethnicity. When no candidate matches the full criteria, the constraints are progressively relaxed by first removing ethnicity, then age, and finally sex, while language is always preserved, until a match is found.
For each selected face source, the reference image is selected on the “best eye pose” (more details in Sec. F.2 ), using the question-answering videos as the starting point.
blocks.zh:
为了产生现实的身份操纵,BabelFake对面部和相声身份都采用了受控的人口配对策略. 对于以面相为主的操纵,每个目标参与者都使用分级的人口配对器与源配对. 人口匹配者基于语言,性别,年龄桶(18-35,35-50,50+),以及种族. 当没有候选人符合全部标准时,限制就会逐渐放松,首先取消种族,然后取消年龄,最后取消性别,同时保留语言,直到找到匹配。
对于每个被选中的面相源,参考图像以"最佳眼姿"(详见Sec.F.2)来选择,以问答视频为起点.

blocks.en: Regarding the fake audio generation, the target provides the video identity and transcript, while the source voice is the reference speech used for voice cloning. By separating facial and vocal identity,  BabelFake supports manipulations in which the target face and voice source are composed of two different participants.
blocks.zh: 关于假音频生成,目标提供视频身份和笔录,而源声则是用于语音克隆的参考演讲. BabelFake通过分离面部和相声身份,支持由两个不同的参与者组成目标相和相声源的操纵.

blocks.en: 4.3 DeepFake Generation
blocks.zh: 4.3 深假生成

blocks.en: We generate manipulated videos using several state-of-the-art DeepFake generation methods, covering 3 3 types of manipulation: face swapping, lip synchronization, and portrait animation . Implementation details and descriptions of all the audio and video manipulation models are provided in Appendix E . Here, we summarize the key characteristics of the employed methods and respective generation settings; note, only three methods predate 2025, all others are very recent.
blocks.zh: 我们使用几种最先进的DeepFake生成方法制作被操纵的视频, 附录E提供了所有音频和视频操作模型的实施细节和说明。 在此,我们总结了所使用的方法和各自世代环境的主要特点;注意到,在2025年之前,只有三种方法,其他所有方法都是最近才出现的。

blocks.en: Face Swapping. We use CanonSwap [ 37 ] (2025), DeepLive Cam [ 19 ] (2025), HiFiFace [ 55 ] (2021), and InSwapper [ 54 ] (2024). For each target video, a face is selected by randomly picking a source matching identity following the rules above ( Sec. 4.2 ). Face-swapping methods preserve the target video’s motion, facial expression, and original audio while replacing the visible facial identity.
blocks.zh: 脸被撕了 使用CanonSwap [37] (2025),DeepLive Cam [19] (2025),HiFiFace [55] (2021),和InSwapper [54] (2024). 对于每个目标视频,通过按照上述规则(sec.4.2.)随机选择源匹配身份来选择一张面相. 脸部相扑方法保留了目标视频的动作,面部表情,以及原始音频,同时取代了可见的面部身份.

blocks.en:
Speech Synthesis & Lip Synchronization . Synthetic audio is generated by conditioning the target transcript on the assigned source voice donor. We use 4 4 multilingual text-to-speech methods: Qwen3-TTS [ 25 ] (2026), FishAudio2 [ 34 ] (2026), OmniVoice [ 59 ] (2026), and ChatterBox [ 41 ] (2025). The synthetic audio is used to drive lip synchronization and a subset of portrait animation methods.
Using KeySync [ 13 ] (2025), LatentSync [ 30 ] (2024), and MuseTalk [ 58 ] (2025), we alter the mouth dynamics of a source video to match a target audio (real or synthetic).
blocks.zh:
语音合成 & Lip同步. 合成音频是通过在指定源语音捐赠者上对目标记录稿进行调节来生成的. 我们使用了4个4个多语种的文本对语音方法:Qune3-TTS [25] (2026),FishAudio2 [34] (2026),OmniVoice [59] (2026),和ChatterBox [41] (2025). 合成音频用于驱动唇相同步和一子集肖像动画方法.
使用KeySync [13] (2025),LatentSync [30] (2024),以及MuseTalk [58] (2025),我们改变源视频的口腔动态,以匹配目标音频(真实或合成).

blocks.en: Portrait Animation. We use AvatarForcing [ 28 ] (2026), PersonaLive [ 32 ] (2025), HunyuanPortrait [ 56 ] (2025), and UniAVGen [ 57 ] (2025) for the last category of manipulations. In this case, starting from a static image of a target identity, animation is driven by audio (AvatarForcing, UniAVGen) or by video (HunyuanPortrait, PersonaLive).
blocks.zh: 肖像动画. 我们使用AvatarForcing [28] (2026年),PersonaLive [32] (2025年),Hunyuan Portrait [56] (2025年),和UniAVGen [57] (2025年)作为最后一类操纵. 在这种情况下,从目标身份的静态图像开始,动画由音频(AvatarForcing,UniAVGen)或视频(HunyuanPortrait,PersonaLive)驱动.

Overall, the dataset contains ∼ \sim 399k video clips, subdivided into ∼ \sim 20k real and ∼ \sim 379k fake videos, spanning 5 5 languages and 3 3 classes of visual plus audio manipulations.

blocks.en: 5.1 Demographic Diversity
blocks.zh: 5.1 人口多样性

blocks.en: The demographic diversity of a DeepFake benchmark is an important factor for evaluating model robustness and reducing population-specific biases. Beyond balancing the number of speakers across languages, BabelFake includes participants with diverse demographic backgrounds in terms of age, sex, ethnicity, and geographic origin. Participants range from 18 to 78 years old, with a median age of 32, and exhibit a nearly balanced sex distribution (49.6% female and 50.4% male). The dataset also includes participants from different ethnic backgrounds, with 72.2% identifying as White, 11.1% Mixed, 8.7% Black, 3.6% Asian, and 4.0% other ethnicities.
blocks.zh: 深假基准的人口多样性是评价模式稳健性和减少特定人口偏见的一个重要因素。 BabelFake除了平衡不同语言的发言者人数之外,还包括在年龄、性别、族裔和地理出身方面具有不同人口背景的参与者。 参与者年龄从18至78岁不等,中位年龄为32岁,性别分布接近平衡(49.6%为女性,50.4%为男性)。 数据集还包括来自不同族裔背景的参与者,其中72.2%为白人,11.1%为混血人,8.7%为黑人,3.6%为亚裔,4.0%为其他族裔。

blocks.en: Figure 1 presents the geographic distribution of participants across (and within) the 5 5 languages. Rather than limiting each language to a single region, the dataset includes speakers from diverse regions worldwide. For example, the English bucket includes speakers from the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, South Africa, and several other countries, while the Spanish and French subsets similarly comprise participants from multiple national backgrounds. This diversity reduces the correlation between language and nationality, encouraging models to prioritize the manipulation artifacts over demographic or geographic cues.
blocks.zh: 图1显示与会者在5种语文之间(以及内部)的地域分配情况。 该数据集没有将每种语言限制在一个区域,而是包括来自世界各地不同区域的发言者。 例如,英语桶包括来自联合王国、美国、加拿大、南非等几个国家的发言者,而西班牙语和法语子集同样包括来自多民族背景的与会者。 这种多样性减少了语言和国籍之间的关联,鼓励模式将操纵文物置于人口或地理提示之上。

blocks.en: Overall,  BabelFake includes participants from 45 countries, providing substantially broader geographic coverage than datasets collected from a single linguistic region.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,Babel 假象包括来自45个国家的参与者,其地理覆盖面远远大于从单一语言区域收集的数据集。

blocks.en: 5.2 Language and Manipulation Distribution

blocks.en:
As summarized in Tab. 2 and Fig. 2 , BabelFake is balanced across 5 5 supported languages, with 98 ​ – ​ 100 98–100 unique participants per language; the real and manipulated samples are roughly balanced per language. This composition minimizes language-specific bias and supports multilingual and cross-lingual evaluation.
Fig. 2 (b) illustrates the distribution across manipulations. The benchmark combines three complementary video manipulation categories, portrait animation, lip synchronization, and face swapping, covering 11 11 state-of-the-art generation methods. Portrait animation and lip synchronization are available with both authentic and synthesized speech, whereas face swapping preserves the original audio, enabling controlled comparisons between visual-only and audio-visual manipulations.

如Tab. 2和Fig. 2所总结的那样, Babel Fake在5种支持语言之间是平衡的,每种语言有98-100个98-100个独特的参与者;真实和被操纵的样本在每种语言之间是大致平衡的。 这种构成将语言特有的偏见降到最低,并支持多语种和跨语言的评价.
图2(b)说明了各种操纵的分布情况。 该基准结合了三个互补的视频操纵类,肖像动画,唇相同步和相相换,涵盖了11个最先进的生成方法. 外观动画和唇相同步同时具有正版和合成的语音功能,而相相交换则保留了原有的音频功能,可以控制地比较仅可视化和视听操纵.

blocks.en: 6.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 6.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We partition BabelFake into identity-disjoint training, validation, and test sets with a 70/10/20 split. We set up the evaluation using three different state-of-the-art models.
blocks.zh: 我们用70/10/20的分数将 Babel Fake 分为身份分裂训练、验证和测试组。 我们用三种不同的最先进的模型来建立评价.

blocks.en:
SpeechForensics [ 33 ] is an unsupervised approach that leverages synchronization to detect DeepFakes. It extracts AV-HuBERT [ 47 ] audio-visual features and evaluates their temporal consistency. The model is trained on LRS3 [ 4 ] and VoxCeleb2 [ 15 ] and, due to its unsupervised nature, does not require any DeepFake-specific fine-tuning. Similarly, AVH-Align [ 48 ] leverages AV-HuBERT representations and is trained on real videos to maximize audio-visual embedding alignment. It also supports a probing layer for supervised DeepFake detection. For the unsupervised baseline, we use the public checkpoints trained on AV-DeepFake-1M [ 12 ] (AV1M). For the supervised setting, we train AVH-Align on MAVOS-DD [ 16 ] and use the available checkpoints on FakeAVCeleb [ 27 ] and AV-DeepFake-1M. Finally, (B)RAVEn [ 22 ] is a self-supervised representation-learning framework, adapted for DeepFake detection via linear probing. We keep the audio-visual encoder frozen and train a single linear layer for binary real/fake classification, considering audio-only (-A), video-only (-V), and audio-visual (-AV) variants. The classification heads are trained on both DeepSpeak [ 9 ] and MAVOS-DD.
Further details are presented in Sec. G.1 .
blocks.zh:
SpeechForensics [33]是一种无监督的方法,利用同步来检测"深假". 它取出AV-HuBERT[47]视听特征并评价其时间一致性. 该型号在LRS3 [4]和VoxCeleb2 [15]上进行了训练,并因其不受监督的性质,不需要任何"DeepFake"特有的微调. 同样地,AVH-Align [48] 利用了AV-HuBERT的表示,并接受了关于真实视频的培训,以最大限度地实现视听嵌入对齐. 它还支持一个可监督的"深假"探测的探测层. 对于无人监管的基线,我们使用经过AV-DeepFake-1M[12](AV1M)训练的公共检查站. 为了监督环境,我们在MAVOS-DD[16]上培训AVH-Align,并使用在FakeAVCeleb[27]和AV-DeepFake-1M上可用的检查站. 最后, (B)RAVEN [22]是一个自我监督的表示-学习框架,通过线性探测来适应DeepFake检测. 我们保留了视听编码器被冻结,并训练出一个单一的线性层,用于二进制真/假分类,考虑的只有音频(-A),视频(-V),以及音频-视频(-AV)等变体. 分类负责人接受深语[9]和MAVOS-DD两个培训.
详情见Sec.G.1。

blocks.en: 6.2 Evaluation Results on BabelFake
blocks.zh: 6.2 关于 Babel Fake 的评价结果

blocks.en: Tab. 12 reports in-domain results, showing that it is “solvable” when training/testing in-domain. More importantly, Table 3 reports the cross-dataset evaluation of state-of-the-art detectors on the test set of the BabelFake benchmark.
blocks.zh: 附表12报告了域内结果,显示在培训/测试域内结果时“可以解决”。 更重要的是,表3报告了BabelFake基准测试数据集对最新探测器的跨数据集评价。

blocks.en: Overall Performance. SpeechForensics achieves the best overall AUC (79.79), showing robust generalization. It performs well on fully synthetic inputs, peaking on PersonaLive [ 32 ] (97.01) and AvatarForcing [ 28 ] (85.45) with fake audio. However, performance degrades significantly on manipulations paired with real audio, such as KeySync [ 13 ] (43.75) and HiFiFace [ 55 ] (63.62), showing the difficulty of detecting visual artifacts when audio cues remain pristine.
blocks.zh: 总体业绩。 SpeechForensics实现AUC(79.79)总体最佳,表现出强力通俗. 它在完全合成的投入上表现良好,在PersonaLive [32] (97.01)和用假音频AvatarForcing [28] (85.45)上达到顶峰. 然而,在与真实音频配对的操纵下,性能会显著地退化,如KeySync [13] (43.75)和HiFiFace [55] (63.62),显示出在音频提示保持原始状态时检测视觉文物的困难.

blocks.en: Multimodal vs Unimodal. Multimodal evaluation consistently yields more balanced detection performance. Under DeepSpeak training, (B)RAVEn-AV achieves 72.05 AUC, outperforming its audio-only (60.09) and video-only (70.31) versions. Similarly, with MAVOS-DD, (B)RAVEn-AV obtains the highest score among the probed models. This trend is consistent across the macro-averages, where multimodal architectures achieve an AUC of 74.27, compared to 71.44 for video-only, confirming that complementary cross-modal information enhances generalization.
blocks.zh: 多式联运与联合多式联运。 多式联运评价始终能产生更平衡的检测效果。 在DeepSpeak训练下, (B)RAVEN-AV实现72.05 AUC,表现优于其仅音频(60.09)和仅视频(70.31)版本. 同样,随着MAVOS-DD, (B)RAVEN-AV在被探测模型中获得了最高分. 这一趋势在宏观平均数上是一致的,即多式联运结构的AUC为74.27,而只有视频的AUC为71.44,这证实了互补的跨模式信息可增强通俗化。

blocks.en: Impact of Training Data. Generalization is highly sensitive to the training dataset. For (B)RAVEn, MAVOS-DD improves the video-only and audio-visual variants over DeepSpeak, while the audio-only model transfers substantially better from DeepSpeak. Training on AV-DeepFake-1M seems to fail, potentially due to its focus on partially manipulated samples rather than fully fake ones. At the same time, AVH-Align Supervised on FakeAVCeleb generalizes effectively (71.37 AUC), achieving the highest performance on the AvatarForcing subset with real audio, which is challenging for the other models.
blocks.zh: 培训数据的影响。 一般化对训练数据集高度敏感. 对于(B)RAVEN来说,MAVOS-DD改进了"DeepSpeak"的视频和视听变体,而"只有音频"的模型则从"DeepSpeak"的传输效果显著. AV-深层假象1培训 M似乎失败了,可能是因为它专注于部分被操纵的样本,而不是完全假的样本. 同时,AVH-Align Supervised on FakeAVCeleb 有效地概括了(71.37 AUC),在有真实音频的"AvatarForcing"子集上实现了最高的性能,这对其他模型都是挑战.

blocks.en: Weakness on Real-Audio Manipulations. Performance varies drastically across generation techniques. In particular, KeySync [ 13 ] and UniAVGen [ 57 ] are harder to detect, on average. Crucially, a consistent degradation emerges across almost every evaluated method: detection accuracy drops in the real-audio scenario compared to the fake-audio. This reveals a common weakness of current detectors when the original audio is preserved. Interestingly, this degradation also affects video-only models, suggesting that the resulting video quality is impacted by using fake audio during synthesis. Overall, video manipulations with real-audio constitute a particularly challenging setting for current detection approaches.
blocks.zh: 虚弱于真实-奥义操纵. 不同发电技术的性能差异很大。 特别是,KeySync [13]和UniAVGen [57] 平均更难被检测. 关键是,几乎所有被评价的方法都出现了持续的降解:检测精度在真声场景中与假声场景相比下降. 这揭示出原始音频保存时,当前探测器的常见弱点. 有趣的是,这种降解也影响了只使用视频的模型,说明由此产生的视频质量受到合成过程中使用假音频的影响. 总的来说,真实的视频操作对目前的检测方法构成特别有挑战性的环境。

blocks.en: 6.3 Multilingual Generalization Results
blocks.zh: 6.3 多语种通览结果

blocks.en: Table 4 : Per-language AUC on the BabelFake benchmark. Results are reported separately for English (EN), German (DE), Italian (IT), French (FR), and Spanish (ES). Bold values indicate the best performance for each language.
blocks.zh: 表 4: Babel Fake基准上的通用语言AUC。 英文(EN)、德文(DE)、意大利文(IT)、法文(FR)和西班牙文(ES)分别报告结果。 粗体值表示每种语言的最佳性能.

blocks.en: Tab. 4 reports per-language performance across English (EN), German (DE), Italian (IT), French (FR), and Spanish (ES). Individual models exhibit different performance patterns across languages, with no language consistently yielding the highest or lowest AUC. This highlights the role of BabelFake as a multilingual benchmark for exposing language-dependent variations in DeepFake detectors.
blocks.zh: Tab. 4 报告英文(EN)、德文(DE)、意大利文(IT)、法文(FR)和西班牙文(ES)的每种语文业绩。 个别模型显示不同语言的性能模式不同,没有一种语言始终产生最高或最低的AUC. 这凸显出BabelFake作为暴露DeepFake探测器中依赖语言的变化的多语种基准的作用.

blocks.en: Overall Performance. SpeechForensics achieves the highest AUC across all five languages, peaking at 83.83 on Spanish and reaching 80.99 on English. The model demonstrates consistent cross-lingual generalization, maintaining an AUC above 77.50 across all language splits. Furthermore, across both (B)RAVEn training schemes, multimodal modeling (-AV) consistently improves over video-only representations (-V) in every language evaluated. Correlation analysis shows that performance on EN diverges from the other languages, highlighting its “special” status in the training data. EN correlates the most with DE, another Germanic language. At the same time, the Romance languages (IT, FR, ES) show strong mutual correlation.
blocks.zh: 总体业绩。 SpeechForensics在所有五种语言中都实现了最高的AUC,西班牙语最高达到83.83分,英语最高达到80.99分. 该模式显示一贯的跨语言通俗化,在所有语言中,AUC保持在77.50以上。 此外,在两个(B)RAVEN培训计划中,多式联运模式(-AV)在所评价的每一种语文中都比仅录相表述(-V)不断改进。 关联性分析显示,EN的性能与其他语言不同,突出了其在培训数据中的“特殊”地位。 EN与另一种日耳曼语DE关系最密切. 同时,罗曼斯语(IT,FR,ES)表现出了强烈的相互关系.

blocks.en: Training Data Bias. Training distributions influence linguistic transfer differently across detector architectures. For (B)RAVEn, MAVOS-DD training yields stronger multimodal transfer on Romance languages such as Italian (77.41 vs. 71.37) and French (75.57 vs. 70.35), whereas DeepSpeak yields higher transfer on English (78.73 vs. 73.09) and German (74.73 vs. 72.38). For AVH-Align, FakeAVCeleb supervision provides the strongest representations overall, consistently outperforming MAVOS-DD and AV-DeepFake-1M on almost all languages. Across all splits, AV-DeepFake-1M yields the lowest transferability, likely due to being focused on local manipulations.
blocks.zh: 培训数据比亚斯。 培训分布对不同探测器结构的语言转移影响不同. 就(B)RAVEN而言,MAVOS-DD培训使意大利语(77.41对71.37)和法语(75.57对70.35)等罗马语的多式转让更加有力,而DeepSpeak语的英文(78.73对73.09)和德文(74.73对72.38)的转让则更高。 对 AVH- Align, 假AKEAV Celeb监督提供了整体上最强的表示,在几乎所有语言上都一直优于MAVOS-DD和AV-DeepFake-1M. 在所有拆分中,AV-DeepFake-1M的可转让性最低,这可能是由于专注于当地的操纵.

blocks.en: Language Robustness. No individual language proves systematically harder or easier across detectors. (B)RAVEn trained on MAVOS-DD performs the best on Italian, while SpeechForensics peaks on Spanish, and AVH-Align supervised on FakeAVCeleb performs the best on German. The absence of a consistent ranking across languages suggests that language sensitivity depends on the detector architecture and training data, highlighting the importance of multilingual evaluation for assessing detector robustness.
blocks.zh: 语言坚固. 任何个别语言都无法系统地证明对探测器更难或更容易。 (B) 接受MAVOS-DD培训的RAVEN在意大利语方面表现最出色,而SpeechForensics在西班牙语方面表现最出色,AVH-Align在FakeAVCeleb方面表现最出色。 不同语言之间没有一致的排名表明,语言敏感性取决于探测器架构和培训数据,突出了多语种评价对评估探测器稳健性的重要性.

blocks.en: 6.4 Performance Across Demographic Subgroups
blocks.zh: 6.4 各人口分组的业绩

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Demographic bias analysis across sex (Female vs. Male) and ethnicity (White vs. Non-white) subgroups on the BabelFake test set. Points report the AUC per subgroup, with connecting bars indicating the performance gap across detector backbones and training datasets.
blocks.zh: 图4: Babel Fake测试集上按性别(女性对男性)和族裔(白人对非白人)进行的人口偏差分析。 点会报告每个分组的AUC,连接条会显示探测器主干线和培训数据集之间的性能差距.

blocks.en: BabelFake’s design allows us to study whether detection methods exhibit systematic demographic biases. For that, we evaluate detector performance across reported sex (Female, Male) and ethnicity (White, Non-white) partitions. Fig. 4 shows the subgroup AUC distributions for each detector. In most cases, performance remains fairly balanced across partitions. Most subgroup disparities however remain below 4 AUC points.
blocks.zh: BabelFake的设计让我们可以研究检测方法是否表现出系统性的人口偏见。 为此,我们评估了报告性别(女性、男性)和族裔(白人、非白人)分区的探测器性能。 发相. 4显示每个探测器的分组AUC分布. 在大多数情况下,各分区的业绩仍然相当平衡。 但是,大多数分组的差距仍然低于哥伦比亚联合自卫军的4分。

blocks.en: Sex and Ethnicity Disparities. Gaps in sex are generally tighter than in ethnicity. For instance, (B)RAVEn-AV trained on DeepSpeak exhibits nearly identical accuracy across female and male subjects, and AVH-Align supervised on FakeAVCeleb shows a minor 0.3 0.3 AUC gap. Larger differences appear under MAVOS-DD training, where both (B)RAVEn-AV (75.8 vs 72.2) and AVH-Align (69.5 vs 65.2) perform significantly better on female subjects, with gaps of 3.6 3.6 and 4.3 4.3 AUC points, respectively. Similar behavior emerges across ethnicity partitions: SpeechForensics exhibits the largest disparity across the benchmark, achieving 81.1 AUC on White subjects compared to 74.7 on Non-white subjects ( Δ = 6.4 \Delta=6.4 ).
blocks.zh: 性别与民族差异. 性别差距一般比种族差距更窄。 例如,(B)RAVEN-AV在DeepSpeak中接受过几乎完全相同的精度测试,在FakeAVCeleb上监督的AVH-Align显示AUC存在0.3-0.3小缺口。 MAVOS-DD培训中出现了较大差异,其中(B)RAVEN-AV(75.8 vs 72.2)和AVH-Align(69.5 vs 65.2)在女性科目上的表现显著好一些,差距分别为3.6分和4.3分。 种族隔阂中也出现类似行为: SpeechForensics显示,整个基准差距最大,白种科的AUC为81.1,而非白种科的AUC为74.7(XQ=6.4\Delta=6.4)。

blocks.en: Impact of Training. Demographic disparities also vary substantially with the training distribution. Models trained on DeepSpeak exhibit small subgroup gaps, remaining below 1.6 1.6 AUC points across both sex and ethnicity. In contrast, MAVOS-DD training produces larger disparities for both unimodal and multimodal (B)RAVEn variants, consistently favoring Female and White subjects.
blocks.zh: 培训的影响。 随着培训的分布,人口差异也相去甚远。 " DeepSpeak " 培训的模型显示出小的分组差距,在性别和族裔方面仍然低于1.6分。 相比之下,MAVOS-DD培训在单式和多式(B)RAVEN两种变体中产生了较大的差异,始终倾向于女性和白人科目。

blocks.en: 6.5 Human Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6.5 人类评价

blocks.en: Table 5: Human evaluation results on a subset of 1,036 videos from the BabelFake benchmark, annotated by 51 participants. Ratings are collected using a four-point scale (1: Real, 2: Probably Real, 3: Probably Fake, 4: Fake). The Deception Rate denotes the percentage of manipulated videos rated as Real or Probably Real (scores ≤ 2 \leq 2 ). For real videos, the same quantity indicates the percentage correctly perceived as genuine. The AUC column reports the average AUC of the multimodal detectors (Avg. AV in Tab. 3 ).
blocks.zh: 表5:对来自BabelFake基准的1 036个分集进行人类评价的结果,51名参与者对此作了说明。 评级采用四分尺度(1.Real, 2: 也许 真实的,3: 可能 假相,4:虚相. 欺骗率表示被操纵的视频被评为"Real"或"可能为Real"(分数为\\2\leq 2)的百分比. 对于真实的视频,同样数量表明正确认为真实的百分比。 联合自卫军栏报告了多式探测器的平均联合自卫军(Avg. AV in Tab. 3)。

blocks.en:
To complement the detector-based evaluation, we conduct an evaluation with fluent language speakers to assess the perceptual realism of the manipulated videos in BabelFake, Tab 5 . The ratings are collected using a 4 4 -point scale (1: Real, 2: Probably Real, 3: Probably Fake, 4: Fake). Based on these ratings, we define the deception rate as the percentage of fake videos perceived as Real or Probably Real (scores ≤ 2 \leq 2 ). InSwapper and CanonSwap achieve the highest deception rate (50%), followed by AvatarForcing (47.5%), MuseTalk (43.8%), KeySync (43.4%), and LatentSync (38.0%), while UniAVGen (26.40%) and PersonaLive (10.90%) are more easily recognized as fake. Participants correctly perceive 87.60% of real videos as genuine. Preserving authentic audio substantially increases the deception rate for KeySync (38.05% to 63.33%), LatentSync (26.92% to 66.67%), and PersonaLive (7.21% to 26.93%), while having a limited impact on AvatarForcing. Overall, the substantial deception rates across several generation techniques confirm that BabelFake contains perceptually convincing manipulations. However, human deception and detector performance show only a moderate inverse correlation ( r = − 0.48 r=-0.48 ), indicating that perceptual realism and machine detection difficulty do not fully align. (e.g., CanonSwap and InSwapper).
See Sec. G.4 for more results.
blocks.zh:
为了补充基于探测器的评价,我们用流利的语言演讲者进行了评价,以评估Babel Fake Tab 5中被操纵的视频的感知现实性。 收视率采用4个4分比分(1:Real; 2: 也许 真实的,3: 可能 假相,4:虚相. 基于这些收视率,我们定义了欺骗率,即认为是Real或可能是Real的假相片的百分比(分数为\\2\leq 2). InSwapper和CanonSwap的欺骗率最高(50%),其次是AvatarForcing(47.5%),MuseTalk(43.8%),KeySync(43.4%)和LatetSync(38.0%),而UniAVGen(26.40%)和PersonaLive(10.90%)则更容易被认作是假. 与会者正确地认为87.60%的真视频是真实的。 保存正宗音频大大增加了KeySync(38.05%至63.33%)、LatetSync(26.92%至66.67%)和PersonaLive(7.21%至26.93%)的欺骗率,但对AvatarForcing的影响有限。 总体而言,几代技术中的大量欺骗率证实了巴别尔活佛包含有洞察力的有说服力的操纵. 然而,人类的欺骗和探测器性能仅显示有中度反相(r=-0.48 r=-0.48),表明知觉现实主义和机器探测难度并不完全一致. (如CanonSwap和InSwapper).
更多结果,见G.4. Sec.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations and Data Distribution. The creation and dissemination of DeepFake datasets carry inherent risks of misuse. To mitigate these risks while supporting reproducible forensic research, BabelFake was developed under institutional ethical guidelines. Unlike datasets that scrape footage without consent, our participants provided informed consent for their biometric data to be manipulated and distributed for academic purposes. BabelFake will not be released publicly on the open web; access will be granted behind a strict, non-commercial research license, following institutional verification and a data-use agreement.
blocks.zh: 伦理考虑和数据分配。 建立和传播DeepFake数据集具有固有的被滥用的风险。 为了减轻这些风险,同时支持可复制的法医研究,Babel Fake是根据机构道德准则开发的。 与未经同意而刮取相片的数据集不同,我们的参与者为他们的生物鉴别数据进行操纵和为学术目的分发提供了知情同意。 Babel Fake不会在公开的网络上公开发布;在机构核查和数据使用协议之后,在严格的非商业研究许可证之后将允许访问。

blocks.en: Limitations and Future Work. While BabelFake significantly broadens the linguistic scope of DeepFake benchmarks by incorporating five languages and participants from 45 countries, it currently focuses on Germanic and Romance languages (English, German, French, Italian, and Spanish). Consequently, the benchmark does not capture the phonetic and visual-speech dynamics of non-Latin-script languages (e.g., Mandarin, Arabic, or Hindi), which remain an important avenue for future extensions. Furthermore, although our pipeline incorporates 15 state-of-the-art generative models, the rapid pace of generative AI means synthesis artifacts will continually evolve.
blocks.zh: 限制和未来工作。 虽然BabelFake通过纳入来自45个国家的5种语言和参与者,大大地拓宽了DeepFake基准的语言范围,但目前它侧重于日耳曼语和罗马语(英语,德语,法语,意大利语和西班牙语). 因此,该基准没有记录非拉丁语语言(如普通话、阿拉伯语或印地语)的语音和视觉语音动态,这仍然是今后扩展的重要途径。 此外,虽然我们的管道包含了15个最新基因模型,但基因AI的快速速度意味着合成文物将不断演变。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduced BabelFake, a consent-first multilingual audio-visual DeepFake benchmark. By combining a controlled webcam acquisition protocol with a modular synthesis pipeline, BabelFake disentangles visual manipulations from synthetic speech. This enables a systematic diagnostic evaluation of state-of-the-art multimodal detectors. Our benchmarking reveals that detection outcome strongly depends on the audio-visual generation pairing, with substantial performance decrease when authentic audio is preserved. Cross-lingual evaluation shows no language consistently harder across detectors; sensitivity instead varies across architectures and training data. Further, fine-grained demographic evaluation exposes detector- and training-specific subgroup disparities that can be obscured by aggregate performance. Finally, human evaluation shows that perceptual realism and machine-detection difficulty do not fully align. BabelFake provides a rigorous, ethically sourced foundation for developing fair, language-agnostic, and modality-robust DeepFake detection systems.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了Babel Fake,这是同意的第一个多语种视听DeepFake基准。 BabelFake通过将受控的网络相机获取协议与模块化合成管道相融合,将视觉操纵从合成语音中分离出来. 这有助于对最先进的多式探测器进行系统的诊断评估。 我们的基准显示,检测结果在很大程度上取决于视听生成的配对,在保留了真实音频后,性能会大幅下降。 不同语言的评价显示,各探测器之间没有任何语言比以往更难;而不同结构和培训数据之间的敏感性则不同。 此外,精细的人口评价暴露出针对探测器和培训的分组差异,这些差异可能被总体业绩所掩盖。 最后,人类评价显示,知觉现实主义和机器探测困难并不完全一致. 宝贝 假为开发公平、语言不可知和模式-robust DeepFake检测系统提供了一个严格、符合道德来源的基础。

blocks.en: Appendix A Informed Consent Form
blocks.zh: 事先知情同意程序

blocks.en: As the dataset was collected from human participants, all contributors were required to provide informed consent before participating. The consent form describes the purpose of the study, the types of data collected, the intended use of the recordings, the potential risks associated with participation, and participants’ rights regarding the deletion of their data. The full consent form used during data collection is presented below.
blocks.zh: 由于数据集是从人类参与者收集的,所有贡献者都必须在参与之前提供知情同意。 同意表说明了研究的目的、所收集数据的种类、录音的预期用途、与参与有关的潜在风险以及参与者删除其数据的权利。 数据收集过程中使用的完全同意表格如下:

blocks.en: Please read the following information carefully. Purpose of the Study This study aims to collect short video responses to create a research dataset for developing and evaluating deepfake detection systems. Deepfakes are videos that have been digitally altered to change a person’s face, voice, expressions, or what they are saying using artificial intelligence. In this project, we will generate benign deepfake videos purely for academic purposes. These generated videos will not depict misleading, harmful, or inappropriate content. Your participation will help ensure that future deepfake detection systems are fair, accurate, and effective across different genders, skin tones, languages, and cultural backgrounds. What You’ll Do During the study, you will interact with a chat-like interface that presents a series of prompts. For each prompt, you will record a short video response (including both video and audio) using your camera and microphone. There are three types of recordings you will be asked to make: • Reading Aloud: You will be shown short pieces of text, such as a sentence, a few sentences, or a short paragraph, and asked to record yourself reading them aloud. • Question Answering: You will be asked simple, general questions (e.g., about hobbies, daily activities, or opinions on neutral topics) and record your spoken responses. • Action Prompts: You will be asked to perform simple gestures (such as nodding, turning your head, or gesturing with your hands) or show a natural facial expression (such as smiling) while speaking a short phrase. All texts, questions, and actions are carefully designed to be neutral and non-offensive. You are not required to share personal or truthful information and may freely invent responses if you prefer. Use of Public-Domain Texts Some reading-aloud prompts are taken from books in the public domain. Whenever a sentence or passage originates from such a source, the title of the book will be displayed alongside the text. If you encounter a sentence or passage that you believe is inappropriate, outdated, or otherwise problematic, you may flag it within the interface. All flagged items will be reviewed and, if deemed inappropriate, removed from future versions of the study. Privacy and Data Collection We process your data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Your video responses will be recorded and stored securely on our local servers. The collected and generated data will only be made available to vetted researchers upon request and will be used exclusively for research purposes. Data Collected • Video and audio recordings • Demographic information (e.g., age, gender, ethnicity, language proficiency) • Device information (microphone and webcam characteristics) Risks Associated with Participation Although all data will be handled with care, there is a small risk of data misuse, such as unauthorized redistribution or manipulation of the dataset. To minimize these risks, dataset distribution is governed by a strict license agreement that: • Restricts the use of recordings and generated data to academic, non-commercial research. • Prohibits redistribution, resale, or repurposing outside approved research contexts. • Requires proper attribution and compliance with ethical guidelines. In addition, all data will be stored securely and access will be limited to authorized researchers. While these safeguards substantially reduce the likelihood of misuse, no system can provide an absolute guarantee against unauthorized use once data have been shared. Your Rights Participation in this study is entirely voluntary. You may stop participating at any time or withdraw your consent at a later stage without penalty or disadvantage. It is important to distinguish between stopping participation before completing the survey and withdrawing consent after completion. 1. If you stop participating during the survey • You may exit the survey at any point before submitting your final responses. • Any recordings made up to that point will be permanently deleted. • No data from an incomplete session will be used for research purposes. 2. If you withdraw your consent after completing the survey • You may request the removal of your data from our storage at any time. • Your data will not be included in future releases of the dataset. • However, if the dataset has already been distributed to approved researchers, we cannot guarantee that previously distributed copies can be recalled or modified. You have the right to know which data concerning you have been stored and to request correction or deletion where applicable. As noted above, we can only guarantee that future releases of the dataset will reflect deletion or correction requests. blocks.en: C.1 Participant Recruitment

blocks.en:
We collected the dataset in four stages: one pilot study and three subsequent collection phases.
During the pilot study, we selected participants solely on the basis of their native or fluent language, without any additional demographic constraints. To increase accent diversity relative to existing DeepFake datasets, our recruitment focuses on speakers living outside the United States.
Following the pilot study, we refined the screening criteria. First, we required the study’s target language to match the participant’s primary language and introduced demographic-balancing targets. The goal was to recruit approximately 48% male, 48% female, and 4% non-binary participants. We largely achieved these targets across all language groups. However, recruiting non-binary participants proved more challenging for some languages. The French and German cohorts fell short of the target by one and two participants, respectively.
For the second and third English collection phases, we restricted recruitment to native English speakers living in the United Kingdom, the United States, Ireland, Australia, Canada, and New Zealand.
blocks.zh:
我们分四个阶段收集数据集:一个试点研究和三个随后的收集阶段。
在试点研究期间,我们仅根据本地语言或流利语言挑选参与者,而没有任何额外的人口限制。 为了突出与现有DeepFake数据集相比的多样性,我们征聘的重点是居住在美国境外的发言者。
在试点研究之后,我们完善了筛选标准。 首先,我们要求研究的目标语言与参与者的主要语言相匹配,并引入人口平衡目标。 目标是征聘约48%的男性、48%的女性和非二年级学员。 我们基本上在所有语言群体中实现了这些目标。 然而,征聘非二进制参与者对于某些语言来说更具挑战性。 法国队和德国队分别有1人和2人没有达到目标。
在第二和第三个英文收集阶段,我们只招聘居住在联合王国、美国、爱尔兰、澳大利亚、加拿大和新西兰的英语母语者。

blocks.en: C.3 Prompt Sources and Selection

blocks.en: The voice cloning component of BabelFake relies on two forms of standardized speech material. First, participants record a language-specific version of The North Wind and the Sun [ 3 ] . Phonetic and linguistic researchers use this passage widely, and it appears in the Handbook of the International Phonetic Association [ 6 ] . Because it is available in multiple languages and offers broad phonetic coverage, it is well-suited to cross-language speaker analysis and voice cloning.
blocks.zh: BabelFake的语音克隆部分依赖于两种形式的标准化语音材料. 一,与会者收录"北风与太阳"特有语言版[3]. 语言学和语言学研究者广泛使用这一段落,并出现在"国际语言学协会手册" [6]. 由于它以多种语言提供,并提供了广泛的语音报道,因此它非常适合跨语言的扬声器分析和语音克隆.

blocks.en: Alongside this paragraph, participants record a set of phonetically balanced sentences. Following the design philosophy of DeepSpeak [ 9 ] , which uses Harvard Sentences for English [ 43 ] , BabelFake uses language-specific, Harvard-style sentence collections or equivalent phonetically balanced corpora for each language [ 17 , 8 , 7 , 38 ] . The sentence sets give us controlled speech samples with broad phonetic coverage while keeping a natural linguistic structure.

blocks.en:
These prompts come from the M-AILABS corpus [ 49 ] , which provides a large collection of multilingual text, allowing for the generation of diverse prompts across different languages and speaking styles.
To improve consistency across recordings, we filter out candidate sentences with estimated reading times under 7 seconds or over 12 seconds. The remaining prompts take about 10 seconds to read on average.
Additionally, to keep content safe, we run all the candidate sentences through a hate-speech detection model [ 5 ] . Following this step, we drop those sentences flagged as potentially harmful.
blocks.zh:
这些提示来自M-AILABS教程[49],它提供了一大批多语种文本,可以生成不同语言和说话风格的不同提示.
为了提高录音的一致性,我们过滤出候选句子,估计阅读时间不到7秒或超过12秒。 其余的提示平均读取需要约10秒.
此外,为了保证内容安全,我们通过仇恨言论检测模式来管理所有候选判决。 在此步骤之后,我们撤消那些被标注为可能有害的句子。

blocks.en:
After filtering, we convert the remaining sentences into phoneme sequences and rank them using a phonetic richness score. We compute the score as 0.5 ⋅ N unique + 0.3 ⋅ N total + 0.2 ⋅ L 0.5\cdot N_{\text{unique}}+0.3\cdot N_{\text{total}}+0.2\cdot L , where N unique N_{\text{unique}} denotes the number of unique phonemes, N total N_{\text{total}} the total number of phonemes, and L L the sentence length.
Sentences were subsequently clustered using TF–IDF [ 45 ] representations of their phoneme sequences, allowing phonetically similar utterances to be grouped together and promoting diversity in the final selection.
blocks.zh:
过滤后,我们把剩下的句子转换成通电话序列,并使用语音丰富的分数来进行分级. 我们计算得分为:0.5分 + 0.3分 + 总分 + 0.2分 + L 0.5\cdot N_{\text{unique}}+0.3\cdot N_{\text{tot}}+0.2\cdot L,其中N unique{unique}表示出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出入出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出入出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出入出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出
随后,用TF-IDF[45]表示其电话序列的方式对判决进行分组,使口头上相似的言论能够组合在一起,并促进最后选择的多样性。

blocks.en:
To build the emotion reading tasks, we employ sentiment classification on the chosen sentences, sorting each prompt into a positive, neutral, or negative sentiment category.
We use the sentiment labels as a coarse filtering heuristic for the target emotion prompts (happy, sad, surprised, and neutral). We pull happy prompts mostly from the positive sentiment group, and sad prompts from the negative group. Surprised prompts come from the remaining positive samples, and neutral prompts come strictly from the neutral category. If we run short on prompts for a specific category, we draw extra sentences from the neutral pool.
blocks.zh:
为了构建情感读取任务,我们在所选句子上采用了情感分类法,将每个提示排序为正,中,或负情绪类.
我们使用情绪标签来粗糙地过滤目标情绪(快乐、悲哀、惊讶和中性)。 我们主要从积极情绪组抽出快乐的提示,从消极情绪组抽出悲伤的提示。 出乎意料的提示来自所剩的正样本,而中性提示严格来自中性类别. 如果我们对一个特定类别没有提示,我们从中性集合中抽出额外的句子.

blocks.en: Appendix E Generation Methods

blocks.en: E.1 Audio Models
blocks.zh: E.1 音频模型

blocks.en: For audio generation, we employ four multilingual text-to-speech models: Qwen3-TTS [ 25 ] , FishAudio2 [ 34 ] , OmniVoice [ 59 ] , and ChatterBox [ 41 ] . Qwen3-TTS is an open-source multilingual text-to-speech model that supports zero-shot voice cloning from short reference audio samples. The model captures speaker-specific characteristics, such as timbre and speaking style, and generates novel utterances that preserve the target speaker’s vocal identity. FishAudio2 provides rapid voice cloning from short reference recordings, typically requiring only 10-30 seconds of speech. It can synthesize arbitrary utterances while maintaining speaker characteristics and natural prosody, enabling realistic speaker-consistent speech generation. OmniVoice is a multilingual text-to-speech model that combines language-agnostic speech representations with diffusion language models to achieve high-fidelity speech synthesis and speaker transfer. Given a short reference recording, it generates arbitrary utterances while preserving speaker-specific attributes, including vocal timbre and prosodic patterns. ChatterBox supports zero-shot voice cloning and expressive speech synthesis from short reference audio. Beyond preserving speaker identity and speaking style, the model provides controllable emotional expressiveness, enabling diverse speech realizations from the same speaker.
blocks.zh: 对于音频生成,我们采用四个多语言的文本对语音模型:Qune3-TTS [25],FishAudio2 [34],OmniVoice [59],和ChatterBox [41]. Qune3-TTS是一种开源多语种文字对语音模型,支持从短相参考音频样本中进行零镜头语音克隆. 该模型捕捉到演讲者特有的特征,如发抖和说话风格等,并产生出保留了目标演讲者相声特征的小说. FishAudio2从简短的参考录音中提供快速语音克隆,一般只需要10-30秒的语音. 它可以综合任意的言论,同时保持演讲者的特点和自然的发音,使现实的演讲者与一致的演讲产生成为可能. OmniVoice是一个多语种的文本对语音模型,将语言-不可知语音表达与传播语言模型相结合,以达到高信度语音合成和扬声器传输. 由于参考记录很短,它产生任意的言语,同时保留了演讲者特有的属性,包括声调平缓和平缓模式. 闲聊 Box支持从简短的参考音频进行零镜头语音克隆和表达式语音合成. 该模型除了保留演讲者身份和演讲风格外,还提供可控的情感表达,使同一位演讲者能够实现多样的演讲.

blocks.en: We leverage the zero-shot voice-cloning capabilities and the multilingual nature of these models to generate realistic audio DeepFakes. The synthesized speech is subsequently combined with video generation engines to produce the final audio-visual fake samples.
blocks.zh: 我们利用零镜头语音克隆能力和这些模型的多语种性质来生成现实的音频"深假". 被合成的语音随后与视频生成引擎结合,生成最终的视听假样.

blocks.en: E.2 Video Models
blocks.zh: E.2 视频模型

blocks.en: Following the recent literature, we consider three categories of video manipulation: face swapping , lip synchronization , and portrait animation . Face swapping replaces the identity of a target subject while preserving facial motion; lip synchronization alters mouth movements to match a target speech signal without changing the speaker’s identity; and avatar/talking-head animation synthesizes an entire facial performance from a reference portrait or avatar.
blocks.zh: 以及肖像动画。 面相交换在保留面相运动的同时取代了目标对象的身份;唇相同步会改变口相动作,以匹配目标语音信号而不会改变演讲者的身份;而相声/相声-头相动画从参考肖像或相声合成了整个面相表现.

blocks.en: Face swapping replaces the identity of the target subject while preserving facial dynamics, including head pose, facial expressions, and eye movements. CanonSwap [ 37 ] performs identity transfer in a canonical facial space, explicitly disentangling identity from facial motion. After removing motion-related information, the source identity is injected into the canonical representation, thereby restoring the original facial dynamics and improving temporal consistency while preserving expressions, head pose, and lip synchronization. DeepLiveCam [ 19 ] is a real-time face swapping framework designed for both prerecorded videos and live webcam streams. It combines robust face detection, identity replacement, and face enhancement to generate temporally coherent face-swapped videos with minimal user intervention. HiFiFace [ 55 ] leverages a 3D shape-aware identity representation to preserve the geometric characteristics of the source face during identity transfer. Combined with a Semantic Facial Fusion module, it adaptively merges source identity and target facial attributes, producing realistic face swaps while maintaining pose, expression, and illumination consistency. InSwapper [ 54 ] uses InsightFace to detect and localize facial landmarks, aligns the source and target faces, and then superimposes the transformed source identity onto each target frame.
blocks.zh: 面相交换在保持面相动态,包括头部姿势,面部表情,和眼睛运动的同时,取代了被攻击对象的身份. CanonSwap [37] 在犬形面部空间中进行身份转移,明确区分出面部运动中的身份. 在去除与运动有关的信息后,将源身份注入犬形代表,从而恢复了原始的面部动态,并改进了时间一致性,同时保留了表情,头姿,和唇同步. DeepLiveCam [19]是一个实时面相交换框架,既为预录视频,也为活生生的网络相机流所设计. 它结合了强健的面相检测,身份替换,和面相增强,生成时间上一致的面相覆盖的视频,而用户干预也很少. HiFiFace [55] 利用3D外形感知身份代表,在身份转移过程中保留出源面的几何特征. 它与语义面相融合模块结合,适应性地将源身份和目标面部属性相融合,在保持姿势,表情和发光一致性的同时产生现实相换. InSwapper [54] 使用InsightFace来检测并定位面部地标,将源与目标面相对齐,再将已变形的源身份叠加到每个目标框上.

blocks.en: Both HiFiFace and InSwapper are generated through the FaceFusion Library [ 44 ] .
blocks.zh: HiFiFace和InSwapper都通过FaceFusion库生成[44].

blocks.en: Lip synchronization modifies only the mouth region to match a target speech signal while preserving the speaker’s identity, facial appearance, and the remaining facial dynamics. KeySync [ 13 ] is a two-stage lip synchronization framework designed to produce high-resolution, temporally consistent talking-face videos. The method explicitly addresses two major challenges of lip synchronization: expression leakage from the source video and facial occlusions. It introduces a masking strategy that suppresses undesired facial expressions while preserving identity and background information, resulting in realistic lip movements with improved temporal consistency and robustness to occlusions. LatentSync [ 30 ] is an end-to-end audio-conditioned latent diffusion framework. It performs lip-sync generation directly in the latent space without relying on intermediate motion representations. To improve temporal consistency, it introduces a Temporal REPresentation Alignment (TREPA) module that aligns temporal video features across consecutive frames, while enhanced SyncNet supervision strengthens audio-visual synchronization. The resulting videos exhibit accurate lip movements, high visual quality, and temporal coherence. MuseTalk [ 58 ] is a real-time audio-driven lip synchronization framework that generates high-quality talking-face videos by performing latent space inpainting on the mouth region. The method leverages a pretrained latent diffusion model, along with audio and visual encoders, to synthesize realistic lip movements while preserving the target identity, facial expressions, and head pose. Its latent-space formulation enables efficient inference while maintaining high visual fidelity and accurate audio-visual synchronization.
blocks.zh: Lip同步只改变口腔区域,以匹配目标语音信号,同时保持演讲者的身份,面部外观,并保持剩余面部动态. KeySync [13]是一个双相唇同步框架,旨在制作高分辨率,时间上一致的谈话相片. 该方法明确解决了唇同步的两大挑战:源视频的表达渗出和面部闭塞. 它引入了一种遮掩策略,压制不受欢迎的面部表情,同时保留身份和背景信息,导致现实的嘴唇运动,并增强了时间一致性和对被隔离的强烈性. LatentSync [30] 是一个端到端的有音频条件的潜在扩散框架. 它在潜在空间直接进行口腔合成,而不依赖中间运动表达。 为了提高时间一致性,它引入了Timpolar REPRespentation Accord(TREPA)模块,该模块将时间视频功能连成一串,同时加强SyncNet监督,加强视听同步. 由此产生的视频显示出准确的口语动作、高视觉质量和时间一致性。 MuseTalk [58]是一个实时音频驱动的唇形同步框架,通过在口区进行潜入空间的涂装来生成高质量的口相声视频. 该方法利用预先训练的潜在扩散模型以及音频和视觉编码器,在保留目标身份、面部表情和头部姿势的同时,合成现实的唇动能。 其潜在的空间配制能够有效推断,同时保持高度的视觉忠诚和准确的视听同步。

blocks.en: Portrait animation synthesizes an entire facial performance from a reference portrait and a driving signal, such as audio or video. Unlike lip synchronization, these methods jointly generate lip movements, facial expressions, head pose, and, in some cases, upper-body motion, while preserving the identity of the reference subject. AvatarForcing [ 28 ] is a diffusion-based talking-head generation model that animates a reference portrait from an input speech signal. By employing a one-step streaming diffusion framework, it generates photorealistic talking-head videos with synchronized lip movements, stable facial identity, and temporally consistent facial dynamics, enabling high-quality long-form avatar generation. HunyuanPortrait [ 56 ] is a diffusion-based portrait animation model that animates a reference image using motion extracted from a driving video. It explicitly disentangles identity and motion through separate appearance and motion representations, enabling accurate lip synchronization while preserving facial identity and generating realistic facial expressions, head movements, and upper-body dynamics. PersonaLive [ 32 ] is a diffusion-based portrait animation model that synthesizes expressive talking-head videos from a reference image. It leverages hybrid motion representations to jointly model facial expressions and head movements while preserving the subject’s identity, and adopts a streaming diffusion framework to generate temporally consistent animations with low latency. UniAVGen [ 57 ] is a unified audio-visual generation model that jointly synthesizes synchronized speech and talking-head videos using dual diffusion transformers. Through asymmetric cross-modal interactions and face-aware modulation, the model explicitly couples audio and visual generation to improve lip synchronization, temporal consistency, and identity preservation. In our pipeline, we employ UniAVGen for talking-head animation from speech.

blocks.en: All generation methods are employed out of the box, using their publicly available implementations. For each method, we follow the released code and the corresponding preprocessing and inference pipelines, including the required input preparation, face detection and alignment, audio preprocessing, and post-processing steps, whenever applicable. We do not introduce modifications to the underlying architectures or generation procedures. This setup is intended to reflect each method’s publicly released generation pipeline, support reproducibility, and provide a representative evaluation of contemporary DeepFake generation techniques.

Because these transcripts exclusively serve as intermediate text prompts for TTS voice-cloning engines (rather than evaluation targets), word-for-word ground-truth precision is secondary to phonetic naturalness. If the driving audio exceeds the source video by Δ ​ t > 0.5 \Delta t>0.5 s, the pair is discarded rather than looped or frozen, preventing synthetic temporal discontinuities from leaking into downstream detector benchmarks.

Model Setup While SpeechForensics [ 33 ] is evaluated with the pretrained model provided by the authors, we train task-specific models for AVH-Align [ 48 ] and (B)RAVEn [ 22 ] .
For AVH-Align, we train the supervised version using the code released by the authors, without modifying any hyperparameters.

虽然SpeechForensics [33] 是由作者提供的经过预先训练的模型来评价,但我们为AVH-Align [48]和(B)RAVEN [22] 培训任务特定模型.
对于AVH-Align,我们使用作者发布的代码来训练被监督的版本,而不修改任何超参数.

blocks.en: For (B)RAVEn, instead, we use the pretrained Base+ audio and video encoders as frozen feature extractors and train a binary linear probe on top of their representations. The encoders remain frozen throughout training. For each 4-second input clip, we temporally average the encoder outputs to obtain a 768-dimensional representation for each modality. The unimodal classifiers consist of a single 768-to-1 linear layer, while the audiovisual classifier operates on the concatenated 1536-dimensional audio-video representation. We train the linear probes for 10 epochs using AdamW [ 36 ] (learning rate ( 10 − 3 10^{-3} ), weight decay ( 10 − 4 10^{-4} )) and binary cross-entropy [ 46 ] with logits.
blocks.zh: 对于(B)RAVEN来说,相反,我们使用经过预先训练的Base+音频和视频编码器作为冷冻特性提取器,并在它们的表示上再训练一款二进制线性探测器. 编码器在整个训练期间一直被冻结. 对于每4秒的输入片段,我们按时间平均编码器输出,以获得每种模式的768维表示. 单模式分级器由单768至1个线性地层组成,而视听分级器则在相接的1536维音频视频代表上运行. 我们使用 AdamW [36] (学习率(10 - 3 10 - 3 - 3)), 体重衰变(10 - 4 10 - 4) 和 二进制横切 [46] 与对数进行线探测。

blocks.en: In Tables 13 and 14 , we report a fine-grained breakdown of audio-driven visual manipulations. While the main benchmark aggregates results across video synthesis pipelines by considering Fake and Real Audio, here we further break down performance by specific driving audio conditions: ChatterBox [ 41 ] , FishAudio2 [ 34 ] , OmniVoice [ 59 ] , Qwen3-TTS [ 25 ] , and Real Audio. This analysis evaluates whether detection difficulty is governed solely by the visual generation pipeline or modulated by the underlying speech synthesis engine.
blocks.zh: 在表13和表14中,我们报告对音频驱动的视觉操纵进行了细微的分解。 虽然主要基准通过考虑"假"和"真实音频"(Real Audio)来对视频合成管道进行汇总,但我们在此进一步按照具体的驱动音频条件来分解性能:ChatterBox [41],FishAudio 2 [34],OmniVoice [59],Qun3-TTS [25],和"真实音频". 这一分析评价了检测难度是完全由视觉生成管道来调节,还是由基础语音合成引擎来调节.

blocks.en: The results reveal substantial performance variation across audio conditions, particularly for multimodal detectors. For example, the average audio-visual AUC on LatentSync [ 30 ] ranges from 58.57 with Real Audio to 74.32 with OmniVoice; similarly, on KeySync [ 13 ] , performance ranges from 52.94 with Real Audio to 66.39 with OmniVoice. This sensitivity varies across visual engines: PersonaLive [ 32 ] remains consistently detectable across audio sources (78.79–81.23 AUC), whereas KeySync and LatentSync exhibit larger shifts depending on the driving audio. These results show that detection performance depends not only on the visual synthesis method, but also on the specific pairing of audio and visual generation techniques.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,各种音频条件,特别是多式联运探测器的性能差异很大。 例如,LatentSync[30]上的平均视听AUC从58.57与"Real Audio"到74.32与"OmniVoice";同样地,在"KeySync [13]上,表现从52.94与"Real Audio"到66.39与"OmniVoice". 这种灵敏度因视觉引擎而异:PersonaLive [32]在音频来源中始终可以探测到(78.79–81.23 AUC),而KeySync和LatentSync则视驱动音频而显示较大的变化. 这些结果表明,检测性能不仅取决于视觉合成方法,还取决于音频和视觉生成技术的具体配对.

blocks.en: Modality-specific averages further highlight the role of joint audio-visual modeling. Across the full benchmark, audio-only models achieve an average AUC of 52.01, compared with 71.44 for video-only and 74.27 for multimodal architectures. However, the magnitude of this multimodal gain varies considerably across synthesis pairs, indicating that the usefulness of cross-modal cues depends on the artifact profile introduced by each generation pipeline.
blocks.zh: 特定模式的平均值进一步突出了联合视听模型的作用。 在整个基准中,只有音频的模型平均达到52.01AUC,而只有视频的模型是71.44,多式联运的模型是74.27。 然而,这种多式增益的程度因合成配对而大相径庭,表明跨式提示的有用性取决于每一代管道引进的文物简介.

blocks.en: G.4 Human Evaluation Breakdown
blocks.zh: G.4 人类评价

blocks.en: We extend the human evaluation reported in the main paper with a finer-grained analysis of audio-driven manipulations, as shown in Table 15 . Specifically, while the main paper reports results aggregated by video manipulation method, here we additionally break down KeySync, MuseTalk, LatentSync, AvatarForcing, and PersonaLive by audio manipulation. This allows us to examine how different voice-generation methods affect the perceived realism of the resulting audio-visual manipulations.
blocks.zh: 如表15所示,我们扩展了主要文件中报告的人类评估,对音频驱动操纵进行了更细致的分析。 具体地说,虽然主要论文报告的结果是通过视频操纵方法汇总的,但在这里,我们通过音频操纵进一步细分了KeySync,MuseTalk,LatentSync,AvatarForcing,以及PersonaLive. 这使我们能够审查不同的声音生成方法如何影响由此而来视听操纵的感知现实主义。

blocks.en: As in the main paper, real videos provide a reference baseline and are perceived as real in 87.6% of the evaluations. Among manipulated samples, however, the human deception rate varies substantially both across video manipulation methods and across audio conditions. For example, KeySync achieves an overall deception rate of 43.4%, but this ranges from 25.00% with FishAudio2 to 63.33% with real audio. Similarly, for LatentSync, the deception rate ranges from 17.40% with OmniVoice to 66.67% with real audio. These differences indicate that the perceived realism of an audio-driven manipulation depends not only on the visual generation method, but also on the audio used to drive it. Interestingly, the effect of a given audio-generation method is not consistent across visual methods, suggesting an interaction between the audio and visual components rather than a single voice-cloning method being systematically more deceptive.
blocks.zh: 与主要论文一样,真实的视频提供了参考基线,在87.6%的评价中被视为真实的. 然而,在被操纵的样本中,人们的欺骗率因视频操纵方法和音频条件而有很大不同。 例如,KeySync实现43.4%的总的欺骗率,但这与FishAudio2的欺骗率从25.00%到与真实音频的欺骗率从63.33%不等. 同样,对于LatentSync,欺骗率从17.40%与OmniVoice,到66.67%与真实的音频. 这些差异表明,一种音频驱动操纵的感知现实主义不仅取决于视觉生成方法,还取决于用于驱动的音频. 有趣的是,特定音频生成方法的效果在视觉方法之间并不一致,暗示音频和视觉组件之间的相互作用,而不是一种单一的语音克隆方法被系统性地更欺骗.

blocks.en: For comparison with automated detection, we additionally report the average AUC of the best-performing audio-visual deepfake detectors for each condition. Human and machine difficulty do not necessarily follow the same trend. For instance, CanonSwap and InSwapper are perceived as real in 50.00% of human evaluations, while the corresponding average detector AUCs remain 76.59 and 72.42, respectively. More generally, the results suggest that perceptual realism is insufficient to characterize detection difficulty: manipulations that are convincing to human observers may still contain discriminative audio-visual cues that are exploitable by automated detectors, while the relative difficulty of individual audio conditions can differ between humans and detection approaches.
blocks.zh: 与自动探测相比,我们还报告每种情况最佳的视听深假探测器的平均AUC。 人类和机器的困难不一定遵循同样的趋势。 例如,在50.0%的人类评价中,CanonSwap和InSwapp被视作真实,而相应的平均探测器AUC仍然分别为76.59和72.42。 更一般地说,结果显示,感知现实主义不足以描述检测难度:对人类观察者具有说服力的操纵可能仍然包含有歧视性的可被自动检测器所利用的视听提示,而单个音频条件的相对难度可能因人与检测方法而异.
